description: This file defines classes and structures related to a memory aliasing graph used in PyTorch's JIT compiler, including Element, MemoryDAG, and MemoryDAGBuilder, for tracking memory locations and aliasing relationships.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: Represents a node in the points-to graph, tracking aliasing relationships and associated values.

classes.name: MemoryDAG
classes.description: Tracks the aliasing graph of memory locations and provides querying methods.

classes.name: MemoryDAGBuilder
classes.description: Helps construct the MemoryDAG by creating and linking Elements.

methods.name: getMemoryLocations
methods.description: Returns the set of memory locations an Element may point to.

methods.name: mayAlias
methods.description: Checks if two Elements may share a memory location.

methods.name: mayContainAlias
methods.description: Checks if one Element contains aliasing memory with another.

methods.name: fromIndex
methods.description: Converts a compressed index to an Element pointer.

methods.name: collectAllContainedMemoryLocations
methods.description: Collects all memory locations contained within an Element.

methods.name: setWildcards
methods.description: Adds wildcards to the MemoryDAG for aliasing.

methods.name: unsafeMakeFreshValue
methods.description: Creates a new Element representing a fresh value.

methods.name: makePointerTo
methods.description: Links one Element to another, indicating a points-to relationship.

methods.name: addToContainedElements
methods.description: Adds an Element as contained within another.

methods.name: makeFreshValue
methods.description: Creates a new Element for a value that doesn't point anywhere.
